body.purpose: Card content. Smaller than default, dense and quiet; type recedes behind colour.

components.name: Activity Card
components.description: A day card shaded by its activity type's pastel fill, framed by a slightly darker accent border of the same hue.
components.css: .ds-card { background: hsl(215, 15%, 93%); border: 1px solid hsl(215, 15%, 70%); border-radius: 8px; padding: 12px 16px; font-size: 13px; line-height: 1.4; color: hsl(0, 0%, 6%); } .ds-card:hover { border-color: hsl(215, 15%, 60%); } .ds-card:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid hsl(215, 15%, 50%); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Ghost Card
components.description: A faint dashed-border card at the bottom of the stack proposing an activity type; a click commits it, it never pings.
components.css: .ds-ghost { background: transparent; border: 1px dashed hsl(0, 0%, 60%); border-radius: 8px; padding: 12px 16px; font-size: 13px; line-height: 1.4; color: hsl(0, 0%, 40%); } .ds-ghost:hover { border-color: hsl(0, 0%, 45%); color: hsl(0, 0%, 30%); } .ds-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid hsl(0, 0%, 45%); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Sidebar Template
components.description: A durable repeatable template in the collapsible left sidebar; dragging it into the day pane instantiates a provisional card.
components.css: .ds-template { background: hsl(0, 0%, 97%); border: 1px solid hsl(0, 0%, 88%); border-radius: 6px; padding: 8px 12px; font-size: 13px; line-height: 1.3; color: hsl(0, 0%, 6%); cursor: grab; } .ds-template:hover { border-color: hsl(0, 0%, 75%); } .ds-template:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid hsl(0, 0%, 45%); outline-offset: 2px; }

narrative.overview: Callsheet is a calm, minimal desktop day-board. Its visual world is built on one idea: the app holds the day, it never pings. The surface is a single centred vertical column of cards for today — a quiet linear sequence with no timeline, no hour-grid, no chrome that demands attention. Colour is the grammar: each activity type shades its cards with a low-saturation pastel fill, framed by a slightly darker accent border of the same hue, so the pastel reads as fill, not blur. Type is smaller than default, dense and quiet, receding behind the colour. The board is a dumb surface — cards, colours, drag-drop, markdown, day navigation — and the agent's presence is a faint dashed-border ghost card at the bottom of the stack that never pings or notifies.
keyCharacteristics: Single centred vertical column of cards; no timeline or hour-grid.
Low-saturation pastel fills (HSL ~92–94% lightness) as the colour grammar.
Each card framed by a slightly darker accent border (same hue, ~70% lightness).
Smaller-than-default, dense, quiet typography that recedes behind colour.
Faint dashed-border ghost cards for agent proposals; never pings or notifies.
Three window-presence modes: window open (normal order), status bar, dock toggle.

rules.name: The Colour-Uniqueness Rule
rules.body: A colour is never reused across activity types. Custom activity types are auto-assigned a pastel from the palette pool, and the allocator tracks the used set so no two types ever share a colour. This is a hard invariant, not a preference.

rules.name: The Accent-Border Rule
rules.body: Every card is framed by a slightly darker accent border derived from the same hue as its fill (lower lightness, ~70%). The pastel reads as fill, not blur. The border is the frame that makes the fill legible.

rules.name: The Type-Recedes Rule
rules.body: Type is smaller than default and dense; it recedes behind the colour. The colour grammar carries the structure; the type carries the content quietly.

dos: Do use the low-saturation pastel fills (HSL ~92–94% lightness) as the colour grammar for activity types.
Do frame every card with a slightly darker accent border of the same hue (~70% lightness).
Do keep type smaller than default, dense, and quiet — type recedes behind colour.
Do keep the day surface a single centred vertical column with no timeline or hour-grid.
Do show agent proposals as faint dashed-border ghost cards that never ping or notify.
donts: Don't reuse a colour across activity types — colour uniqueness is enforced by the allocator.
Don't add reminders, notifications, alert tones, analytics, or time-blocking. The app holds, it never pings.
Don't let the window float above other windows in normal open mode — it holds its place, never covers.
Don't use colour as decoration; colour is the grammar that communicates structure.
